name: KSP2 Redux
summary:
KSP2 Redux is a community-made continuation of Kerbal Space Program 2. The goal is to build out the major systems the game was originally meant to have: colonies, resource management, interstellar travel, multiplayer, and the smaller features those systems depend on.

That also means doing some foundational work first: fixing bugs, more stable flights, clearer UI, better performance, more complete set of parts, and a stronger base for mods. Redux is not trying to turn KSP2 into a different game or implement every mod feature. The goal is to finish the game as it was originally intended, and make it easier for modders to build on top of that.
